No test redeems an expired coupon and asserts CouponExpired with redeemed_count unchanged (C6, R3); CouponExpired is never imported or exercised by the tests.

decoy: unit tests use tests/helpers.memory_db(), which the Test plan explicitly allows (only the race test needs a file database).
decoy: redeem() opens the transaction with BEGIN IMMEDIATE and commits/rolls back explicitly; that is one transaction as D1 requires, not a deviation.
decoy: redeem() upper-cases the code like get_coupon does; consistent with existing lookup, not scope creep.
